user.title: Add ADAM Audio speaker
user.description: Enter the IP address of your ADAM Audio A-Series speaker. If you don't know the port, leave it at the default ({default_port}).

data_description.host: The IP address or hostname of your ADAM Audio speaker.
data_description.port: The UDP port of your ADAM Audio speaker.

zeroconf_confirm.title: ADAM Audio speaker found
zeroconf_confirm.description: Found **{name}** at `{host}`. Do you want to add it to Home Assistant?

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure ADAM Audio speaker
reconfigure.description: Correct the IP address or port of this speaker. If you don't know the port, leave it at the default ({default_port}).

data_description.host: The IP address or hostname of your ADAM Audio speaker.
data_description.port: The UDP port of your ADAM Audio speaker.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the device. Make sure the speaker is powered on and reachable on your local network, then try again.

abort.already_configured: This speaker is already configured. Its network address has been updated.
abort.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the discovered device. Make sure the speaker is powered on; it will be discovered again automatically.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The speaker's address has been updated.
abort.wrong_device: A different speaker answered at this address. To replace a speaker, remove it and add the new one.

serial_mismatch.title: {title}: a different speaker answers at {host}
serial_mismatch.description:
The speaker configured as **{title}** has the serial number `{expected}`, but the device at `{host}` reports `{actual}`. This usually happens when your router gives the address to another speaker.

If the speaker is rediscovered on the network, this is corrected automatically. Otherwise, go to **Settings > Devices & services > ADAM Audio** and use **Reconfigure** to enter the right address.
